text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At our strategy meeting for the coming year, Curren Chan shows me several Umamusume social media stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The superhero UmaToker, Biko Pegasus. The food Umastagrammer, Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The daily vlog UmaTuber, Taiki Shuttle. And the class representative, Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of them are sprinters. Curren Chan needs to compete with all of them next year, and comes up with a plan to make it happen.
